[USER] User asked for the backstory behind the lyrics of "Stairway to Heaven."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Stairway to Heaven" was written by British rock band Led Zeppelin's guitarist Jimmy Page and vocalist Robert Plant.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The song was released in 1971 and is considered one of the greatest rock songs of all time.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The lyrics are often interpreted as describing a journey from materialism and earthly concerns to spiritual enlightenment.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The song is divided into several sections, each with its own distinct musical style.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The opening lines introduce a materialistic woman who believes she can attain spiritual fulfillment through material possessions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The song progresses to describe a journey through different stages of life and ends with an instrumental section known as the "guitar solo."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Many elements of the song draw inspiration from Celtic mythology.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The song's iconic guitar riff was reportedly inspired by a piece called "Taurus" by the band Spirit.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Overall, "Stairway to Heaven" is seen as a masterpiece of 1970s rock and has influenced countless musicians and listeners over the past few decades.
